mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as investor confidence declines.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in 1 month but SPX posts positive 20-day returns more than 60% of the time, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) above a 50-year historical average signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises above its historical average but SPX returns are negative, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1 percentage point signals increased supply and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by >1pp but SPX returns are not significantly positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increase simultaneously, it indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and PAYEMS increase but SPX returns are negative, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX returns are positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real state and local government purchases (RSAFS) signals increased government demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but SPX returns are not positive, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth outpaces CPI (CPIAUCSL) inflation, it indicates a healthy economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth outpaces CPIAUCSL but SPX returns are not positive, the hypothesis is rejected.
